wholePhysicalScope: The named 146-point basilica outline and OpenStreetMap’s current building relation identify the separate roof, facade, principal dome, lantern, columns, and some smaller rooftop domes. The sacristy has its own attached mapped perimeter.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the full basilica, main ribbed dome, cupolas, facade and sacristy. Near levels add cornices and portico arches, statues, clock and drum detail.
limitations: The facade rhythm, two clocks, thirteen roof statues, dome ribs and lantern are modeled. Sculptures, inscriptions, lettering and fine decoration are represented at landmark scale.

Local rooftop fittings, stair risers, subsidiary dome profiles and some outer window details are approximate. St Peter’s Square, the separate colonnades, the Apostolic Palace and basilica interiors are outside the selected extent.
